decision: closed BTC H4 timestamps; observed BTC signed inventory from native fills strictly before decision; exclude exact-t BTC-fill ties
returns: simple synchronized H1 close returns;720 observations ending strictly before decision (last H1 return end t-1h)
ER24: abs(BTCH4close(t)-BTCH4close(t-96h))/sum(abs(H4 close changes),24 closed H4 increments); close(t) is already closed
trim_actions: for each SOL action, BTCtrim=SOLnotional*betaSOLgivenBTC (equal estimated BTC factor relief); NO_HEDGE reference
gates: nonflat observed BTC, full causal720H1 history, positive covariance/correlation/variances/beta; no selected risk gate or optimized thresholds
outcomes: fixed4h/24h, frozen initial observedBTCqty and observed prices only; endpoint action benefit and H1-close-grid worst combined change vs NO_HEDGE; future actual lifecycle ignored and crossing-native-flat labels flagged
fees: conditional roundtrip each action both legs taker .00055 of entry/exit notional for both BTC and SOL; NO_HEDGE incremental fees0; no originalBTCentry fees charged again
aggregation: means in bp of observedBTCnotional; year and descriptive strata; equalBTCcycle block means for stability, H4 rows not independent; no gate fitted from outcomes
